android.desc:
Reply to email, LinkedIn, and chat messages in seconds with Pragya, the AI Reply Assistant built for people who write a lot of messages every day. Get instant AI-generated replies, rewrites, and summaries directly inside the app you're already using — no copying, no pasting, no switching screens.

Pragya is an AI Reply Generator, AI Writing Assistant, and AI Chatbot in one lightweight Android tool, designed for sales reps, customer support teams, freelancers, recruiters, and founders who need to reply fast without sounding rushed.

💬 AI REPLY GENERATOR
Generate natural, on-brand replies for any conversation.
- Instant AI replies for email, LinkedIn messages, and support chats
- Multiple reply suggestions per message
- Professional, casual, friendly, or concise tone options
- Personalize replies to match your own writing style
- Edit every AI response before sending
- Works inside your current app — no switching required

✍️ AI WRITING ASSISTANT
Write faster and sound sharper everywhere on your phone.
- Draft professional emails and LinkedIn outreach in seconds
- Write and improve social media captions and posts
- Fix grammar, spelling, and tone instantly
- Rewrite sentences to sound more natural or more professional
- Expand, shorten, or simplify any text
- Generate first-draft content in seconds, then edit and send

📝 AI SUMMARIZER
Cut through long emails, articles, and documents.
- Summarize long emails and message threads
- Summarize articles, reports, and webpages
- Extract key points in seconds
- Read less, understand more, respond faster

📱 ON-SCREEN AI ASSISTANT
Get AI help without leaving the app you're in.
Pragya reads the content visible on your screen when you activate it, so it can:
- Explain what's on your screen
- Answer questions about visible content
- Draft a reply using the context already in front of you
- Cut down on copy-pasting between apps

🔄 AI REWRITER & GRAMMAR HELPER
- Rewrite text in a different tone in one tap
- Make casual writing sound professional (or vice versa)
- Fix grammar and spelling automatically
- Polish messages before you hit send
- Built for students, professionals, and content creators

🤖 BUILT-IN AI CHAT
- Ask questions and get fast, clear answers
- Brainstorm ideas or draft content from scratch
- Continue conversations with full context
- Revisit saved chat history anytime
